test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All leaves are trees.

Some trees are plants.

**Conclusions:**

(i) Some leaves are plants.

(ii) All leaves are trees.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements:

All leaves are trees.

Some trees are plants..

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fb4a281058e4901fe1553ba08d7370dc68afe86053595712a8f4e8a543a6ff7.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some leaves are plants.. → **Not F**ollow (There is no direct relation between leaves and plants.)

(ii) All leaves are trees.. → Follow (As all leaves are trees are given in the statement.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
